# Akbar Alfaidah — Tech Agency & Engineering Studio
> Principal Software Engineer specializing in Full-Stack Web Platforms, Mobile Apps, and Applied Machine Learning / Computer Vision. Based in Jambi, Indonesia; available worldwide remotely.

## Core Services
- **Web Platforms & Custom Systems:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, Laravel, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Docker deployment.
- **Mobile Applications:** React Native, Flutter, Android & iOS production releases with geolocation, real-time sync, and offline resilience.
- **Applied AI & Computer Vision:** YOLO detection, BiLSTM / OpenCV pipelines, FastAPI inference services, and automated document extraction.
